summary: Added a read-only Steward Recall Operations view to the Estate Operations Center, including recall lifecycle summaries from existing recall artifacts, active recall status-bar count, source links, missing-artifact handling, and coverage for no recalls, active, delivered, failed, acknowledged, and unknown acknowledgement states.
known_limitations: The recall operations view is read-only and does not send, approve, escalate, or acknowledge recalls.
The view summarizes only existing local artifacts and shows missing sources where artifacts have not yet been produced.
No ledger or devlog entries were modified, per work package constraints.
